one_line_summary: Eric Wan is a veteran Hong Kong television actor best known for his role in the “My Date with a Vampire” series and has recently spoken publicly about the death of director Billy Tang.
extended_summary: Eric Wan Tin‑chiu (born 28 October 1964) built his career after graduating from the ATV Training Course in 1983, beginning as a children’s programme host before moving into drama. He is most recognized for portraying Fong Tin‑yau in the “My Date with a Vampire” trilogy and has appeared in numerous films and series such as *Century of the Dragon* and *Fist of Fury*. In 2024 he publicly expressed sadness over the passing of director Billy Tang, recalling the director’s kindness and laughter. His professional profile also lists academic credentials (MPH, MBA) and a role as a pharma strategist.
key_findings: Eric Wan is a long‑standing Hong Kong television actor, best known for his lead role in the “My Date with a Vampire” series.
His career began after completing ATV’s training program, starting as a children’s show host and expanding to many TV and film credits.
He recently expressed sadness and shared positive memories about director Billy Tang following the director’s death.
